Tinugunan ng lokal na pamahalaan ang ilan sa mga suliranin na kinakaharap ng HOA, kabilang ang ilang isyu sa road safety at traffic management, at garbage collection.

Bukod kay Mayor Joy, dumalo rin sa pulong si District 6 Action Officer Atty. Mark Aldave, Traffic and Transport Management Department Head Dexter Cardenas, Department of Sanitation and Cleanup Works of Quezon City Head Richard Santuile, Zoning Administration Unit Chief Mike Velasco, at Engr. Roylan Swanson ng City Engineering Department.
